caption: A bar of chocolate is broken along its grooves into separate pieces.

sa.check: A bar of chocolate with grooves is held.
The break runs along the grooves.
The bending comes first and the break follows.

pc.expect: The bar snaps cleanly along a groove where it is bent; it does not bend without breaking.
pc.fail: It bends like rubber; or it crumbles; or it melts.

pc.expect: The pieces stay separate and together make up the bar.
pc.fail: They stick back together; or a piece appears from nothing; or the bar is whole again.

pc.expect: The break follows the groove where the bar is bent.
pc.fail: It breaks across a square; or it is bent with no break; or it breaks before bending.
They float; or rise; or hang.

pc.expect: One bar becomes its pieces, and the hands do not pass through it.
pc.fail: The hands pass through the bar; or a second bar appears; or the chocolate turns into another object.

pc.expect: The chocolate's colour and wrapper stay the same.
pc.fail: The chocolate changes colour; or the wrapper changes; or the background rearranges.
